name: rural-sep
description: Open source repository for the RURAL SEP dashboard application.

scripts.build: npm run api:generate && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.ls: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard | grep -v -E '\.(md|yaml|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|ico|webp|mp3|mp4|woff|woff2|ttf|eot|otf|pdf|zip|gz|tar)$' | grep -v -E '^(package(-lock)?.json|webpack.config.mjs|tsconfig.json|.gitignore)$' | awk -F. 'NF>1 { exts[$NF]++ ; files[$NF] = files[$NF] " " $0 } END { for (e in exts) print e, files[e] }' | while read ext files; do echo "$files" | xargs wc -l | tail -n1 | awk -v e="$ext" '{ print e, $1 }'; done | sort | awk '{ count[$1] += $2; total += $2 } END { for (e in count) print e, count[e]; print "total", total }'
